text: reported that the use of montelukast did permit reduction in the dose of inhaled corticosteroid; adding montelukast to an inhaled corticosteroid (budesonide) may be as effective as doubling the dose of the corticosteroid.18 There is some evidence that montelukast may be more effective than inhaled salmeterol for the chronic treatment of exercise-in- duced asthma,19,20 and although a later study21 found similar ef- fects on lung function with the two drugs, a more favourable ef- fect was seen on gas exchange during moderate exercise with the use of montelukast.
